headline: Approved multiple special event and alcohol permits for the Folk Festival and other events; scheduled hearings on a new Dutton Street restaurant license and alcohol rules.
summary: The Commission approved special event and one-day alcohol permits for several summer and fall events, including the Lowell Folk Festival, Open Streets Lowell, and the Humane Society's Muddy Paws 5K. It also approved sidewalk stand permits for several Folk Festival vendors, and voted to hold public hearings on a new restaurant liquor license at 491 Dutton Street and on revising the city's alcohol regulations.
decisions: Approved the special event permit for Joe Carreiro, El Potro Mexican Grill, for live music on July 25, 2026, from 6:15 to 9:15 PM at 128 Merrimack Street.
Approved the special event permit for Sambath Bo, Clemente Park Committee, for a Bicentennial Social Weekend July 31 to August 2 at Clemente Park.
Approved the special event permit for Ethan Yang, DIY Lowell, for 'Open Streets Lowell' on October 3, 2026.
Approved the special one day alcohol license and outdoor entertainment permit for Jonathan Northridge, Lowell Humane Society, for the Muddy Paws 5K & Block Party on September 26, 2026.
Approved the special one day license for Rachel Chandler, Hive Public Market, for 'Sip & Script with Sweet Pig Press' on August 8, 2026.
Approved three special one day licenses for Jay Ebua for the Aghem Family & Development conference, July 31 to August 2, at the Hellenic American Academy.
Approved four special one day wine licenses for Steve Syverson for art show receptions at Arts League of Lowell on August 1, September 12, September 19, and December 12, 2026.
Approved 10 special one day alcohol licenses for Corey Belanger, Lowell Festival Foundation, for the 2026 Lowell Folk Festival on July 24, 25, and 26.
Approved two special one day licenses for Elizabeth Gonzalez for the Lowell Puerto Rican Festival on August 8 & 9, 2026 at JFK Plaza.
Approved three special one day licenses for Kevin Moschen for expanded sidewalk seating at Fuse Bistro, 45 Palmer Street, during the Folk Festival.
Approved a sidewalk stand permit for Pina Amato, The Coffee Mill Emporium, at 23 Palmer Street for the Folk Festival.
Approved a sidewalk stand permit for Ankit Kumar, Total Wireless, at 104 Merrimack Street for the Folk Festival.
Approved a sidewalk stand permit for Jennifer Howell, Sutro Studio, at 51 Market Street for the Folk Festival.
Approved a sidewalk stand permit for Shannon Arenburg, Pizzelle Bakery, at 201 Market Street for the Folk Festival.

Approved a motion to hold a public hearing on the new Wine and Malt Beverages Restaurant license application for Mestiza Latin Kitchen Corp. at 491 Dutton Street, Unit 4, scheduled for the August 13, 2026 meeting.
Approved a motion to hold a public hearing on revising the City of Lowell alcoholic beverages regulations.
Approved a motion to place communications regarding incidents and events on file.

Lowell License Commission | Meeting Minutes for 2026.07.23 
 
City of Lowell License Commission | 375 Merrimack St. Lowell, MA 01852  Page 1 of 5 
 
This meeting was held in City Council Chambers, second floor, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St. on 
Thursday, July 23, 2026, at 6:00 PM, and by Zoom invitation. 
Video of this meeting is available: https://www.youtube.com/@LTCLowellMA  
 
ROLL CALL: 
On a roll call at 18:00, members present were, namely: Commission Chair Donahue, Commissioner Krieger, 
and Commissioner Underwood. Commissioner Mercier was absent. 
  
MINUTES:  
1 Acceptance of the meeting minutes for July 9, 2026.  
Motion to accept the minutes of the July 9, 2026, License Commission meeting by Commissioner 
Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
2 Application by Joe Carreiro, El  Potro Mexican Grill, for a "Special Events Permit for Amplified 
Outdoor Public Entertainment," for Live Music to be held Saturday, July 25, 2026, from 6:15 to 9:15 
PM at 128 Merrimack Street. 
Mr. Carreiro appeared before the Commission in Council Chambers and reviewed his event, noting 
that they’ve had a mariachi band every year at Folk Fest for the last 11 years. 
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
3 Application by Donald Esson, Ma rkley Group, for a "Special Events Permit for Amplified Outdoor 
Public Entertainment," for Live Music to be held Saturday, July 25, 2026, from 11 AM to 9 PM at 1 
Markley Way. Rain Date 8/1. 
Mr. Esson did not appear before the Commission. 
4 Application by Sambath Bo, Clemen te Park Committee, for a "Special Events Permits for Amplified 
Outdoor Public Entertainment," for a Bicentennial Social Weekend to be held on Friday, Saturday, & 
Sunday, July 31 to August 2, at the basketball courts of Clemente Park, 803 Middlesex Street. 
Ms. Bo spoke to the Commission about their event.  
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Krieger. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
5 Application by Ethan Yang, DIY Lowell, for a "Speci al Events Permit for Amplified Outdoor Public 
Entertainment" for 'Open Streets Lowell,' to be held Saturday, October 3, 2026, Noon to 5 PM at  
Merrimack Street between Kirk Street and Central Street. 
Mr. Yang reviewed the plans for the second annual “Open Streets” event and spoke about his 
organizations goals.

Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
6 Application by Jonathan Northr idge, Lowell Humane Society, for a "Special One Day License to 
sell/dispense Wines and Malt Beverages" and for a "Special Events Permits for Amplified Outdoor 
Public Entertainment," for the "Lowell Humane Society's Muddy Paws 5K & Block Party" to be held 
on Saturday, September 26, 2026, from 10 AM to 1 PM,  at the Lowell Human Society, 951 
Broadway Street. Rain Date 9/27. 
Mr. Northridge reviewed his annual event for the Commission.  
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
7 Application by Rachel Chandler, Hive Public Mark et, for a "Special One Day License to sell/dispense 
Wines and Malt Beverages only," for "Sip & Script with Sweet Pig Press," to be held on Saturday, 
August 8, 2026, from 1 to 2:30 PM at Hive Public Market, 101 Paige Street.  
Kerri Velasquez, owner of “Sweet Pig Press,” spoke to the Commission and provided a description of 
the event. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Krieger. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
8 Application by Jay Ebua for three "Special One Day Licenses to sell/dispense Malt Beverages & 
Wines" for the Aghem Family & Development conference on July 31, 8PM - Midnight, August 1, 
4PM to Midnight, and August 2, Noon to 5PM, at the Hellenic American Academy, 41 Broadway 
Street. 
Mr. Ebua went before the Commission and explained his annual family event.  
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
9 Applications by Steve Syverson, for four "Special One Day Licenses to sell/dispense Wines only," for 
the following events at Arts League of Lowell, 307 Market Street: 
• Saturday, August 1, 2026, 2-45 PM: "Illumniations" reception. 
• Saturday, September 12, 2026, 3-5 PM: "The Three of Us" reception. 
• Saturday, September 19, 2026, 3-5 PM: "Shapes & Symbols" reception. 
• Saturday, December 12, 2026, 3-5 PM: "Wrapped for the Holidays" reception. 
Mr. Syverson noted that he was “finishing up” his licensing for art show receptions for the rest of 
the year. 
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED.

10 Applications by Corey Belanger , Lowell Festival Foundation, for  10 "Special One Day Licenses to 
sell/dispense Alcohol" on festival grounds at the 2026 Lowell Folk Festival, to be held on July 24, 25, 
26:  
• JFK Plaza - Arcand Drive "All Alcoholic Beverages" : Friday 6-10:00PM; Saturday 12-10:00PM; 
Sunday 12-6PM. 
• John Street at Boarding House Park "All Alcoholic Beverages" : Friday 6-10:00PM; Saturday 12-
10:00PM; Sunday 12-6PM. 
• Market Street Stage "Beer & Wine" : Saturday 12-9PM & Sunday 12-6PM. 
Mr. Belanger spoke to the Commission, noting that the alcohol service would be the same as the 
last few years’ Folk Festivals. 
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
11 Application by Elizabeth Gonzalez, for two "Speci al One Day Licenses to sell/dispense All Alcoholic 
Beverages" for the Lowell Puerto Rican Festival, to be held on Saturday and Sunday, August 8 & 9, 
2026, from Noon to 9 PM at JFK Plaza, 50 Arcand Drive. 
Ms. Gonzalez went before the Commission to review her annual event, noting that she would have 
police detail as well as private security. 
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
12 Application by Kevin Moschen fo r 3 "Special One Day Licenses to sell/dispense Malt Beverages & 
Wines" for expanded sidewalk seating during the Lowell Folk Festival on July 24, 25, and 26, 2026, at 
Fuse Bistro, 45 Palmer Street. 
Mr. Moschen spoke to the Commission about extra outdoor seating for Folk Festival. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Krieger. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
13 Application by Pina Amato, The Coffee Mill Em porium, for a  "Sidewalk Stand Permit" for their 
business at 23 Palmer Street, for the 2026 Folk Festival. 
Ms. Amato noted that she would be serving non-alcoholic drinks outside again for the festival. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Krieger. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
14 Application by Ankit Kumar, Total Wireless, for a  "Sidewalk Stand Permit" for their business at 104 
Merrimack Street, for the 2026 Folk Festival. 
Mr. Kumar reviewed his business and plans for the festival.

Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Krieger. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
15 Application by Jennifer Howell, Sutro Studio, for a  "Sidewalk Stand Permit" for their business at 51 
Market Street, for the 2026 Folk Festival. 
Ms. Howell reviewed her business and plans for the festival. 
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
16 Application by Shannon Arenburg,  Pizzelle Bakery, for a "Sidewalk Stand Permit" for their business 
at 201 Market Street, for the 2026 Folk Festival. 
Ms. Arenburg reviewed her plans for the festival and confirmed that she would have bread. She also 
confirmed that her stand would not interfere with pedestrians and the sidewalk. 
Move approval by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 
absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
17 Request for a Public hearing for an applicatio n by Mestiza Latin Kitchen Corp., Luisa Fernanda 
Lopera, proposed license manager, for a new "Wine and Malt Beverages" Restaurant license for 491 
Dutton Street, Unit 4. Request public hearing be held at the August 13, 2026, License Commission 
meeting. 
Motion to hold a public hearing on this matter by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by 
Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
18 Request for a public hearing regarding the revision of City of Lowell alcoholic beverages regulations. 
Commissioner Krieger requested a report from Lowell Police Department comparing alcohol 
incident statistics from Lowell to other comparable municipalities. Captain Peaslee agreed he would 
obtain what data he could. 
Motion to hold a public hearing on this matter by Commissioner Krieger; seconded by 
Commissioner Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
19 Communications to Commission regarding incidents and events. 
Motion to place the matters on file by Commissioner Donahue, seconded by Commissioner 
Underwood. 3 yeas, 1 absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
20 Adjournment. 
 
ADJOURNMENT: 
Commissioner Krieger made a motion to adjourn at 18:27, seconded by Commissioner Underwood.  
3 yeas, 1 absent (C. Mercier), APPROVED.
